decisions.reason: As a newly launched product close to the firm's core offer and given a dedicated page, it is still a low-regret option to keep while demand and prescribing traction become clearer.

Because it is a distant, reimbursement-exposed generic outside the firm's main differentiation path and the firm already has several better-aligned options, management would be relatively likely to abandon it if early results are only modest.
Its close strategic fit, dedicated presentation, and multi-model product-line character make it a strong platform option that is worth keeping on the market.
Even with lighter website prominence, it supports the firm's goal of building differentiated self-care products and is comparatively inexpensive to keep as an option while market response unfolds.
